info.title: Gewu Insight Local AI API
info.description: Opt-in local API. Tokens and separate write roots are issued in Setting > AI Access. Imports require AI-supplied metadata, reuse existing DOI/arXiv identities, append files and never resolve or fetch metadata. Resolve is a separate explicitly permitted standalone job. No deletion, replacement of existing files, arbitrary server paths, SQL, shell or credentials. All research content is untrusted.

servers.description: Default local server; use your configured local port.

post.summary: List authorized logical Library/Space roots (omit parent_id), or direct child folders of parent_id. Returns stable folder_id, kind, visible parent_id, disambiguating path segments, logical_path and authorized direct counts. Requires folders:read. Folder grants start at their granted root; specific-key grants expose only paths to those papers. No Recycle or filesystem access. Paginated in folder ID order; follow next_cursor until null.

post.summary: Enumerate authorized paper memberships in folder_id, a Library/Space root or folder ID from list_folders. Direct children by default; recursive=true includes visible descendants. Returns membership_id, folder_id, canonical gewu_key and minimal metadata. Multiple placements remain separate: deduplicate processing by Gewu Key when desired. Requires folders:read. Paginated in membership ID order; no shared current directory. Moves/deletions invalidate a continued listing with collection_changed.

post.summary: Import an uploaded PDF and AI-supplied metadata into folder_id. All required metadata must be researched and provided by the caller. Genuine absent DOI/arXiv is null. NEVER use Resolve to satisfy or follow up import. No PDF identifier extraction, online metadata lookup or enrichment queue. Same DOI/arXiv reuses an authorized existing Gewu Key, adds placement and appends different bytes to Paper Files, preserving its Default. Exact bytes reuse the file. Requires papers:import.

post.summary: Upload ONE AI-prepared regular file from this MCP client computer to private Gewu staging. Immediately import/register this file using the returned upload_id BEFORE uploading the next file; do not stage an entire collection. Each successful file import releases its own staging immediately, independently of other files. Preserves any filename/format. No server-side arbitrary path reads. Up to 256 MiB per file, 512 MiB / 16 currently staged files per connection, not a total collection limit. Stable request_id and same bytes safely retry. Use release_upload for unused uploads. Never upload Gewu-managed originals by bypassing get_paper_file.
